function.name: uber_ride
function.description: Initiates an Uber carpool ride from a specified location and provides options for ride type, along with an estimated wait time for the customer. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

loc.description: The starting location for the Uber ride in the format of 'Street Address, City, State'. For example, '1 Market St, San Francisco, CA'.

type.description: The type of Uber ride the user is requesting.

time.description: The maximum time the customer is willing to wait for the ride, in minutes.

| **Winter (Dec–Feb)** | 5 – 15 °C | Cool mornings, occasional drizzle, evenings can feel chilly. |
| **Spring (Mar–May)** | 12 – 22 °C | Warm days, mild nights, occasional showers. |
| **Summer (Jun–Aug)** | 24 – 32 °C | Hot and humid, frequent afternoon thunderstorms. |
| **Autumn (Sep–Nov)** | 18 – 26 °C | Pleasant temperatures, lower humidity, occasional rain. |

If you need a current forecast or more detailed information (e.g., humidity, wind speed), you could check a reliable weather website or app such as AccuWeather, Weather.com, or the local meteorological service. Let me know if there’s anything else I can help with!
